lesson: The system is consistently failing by entering low-confidence setups against the primary 4h/1d trend, resulting in 'catching falling knives' or fighting momentum. The low win probabilities (20-36%) indicate that the current SMC-based entries are ignoring the broader market structure and liquidity sweeps.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Alignment Filter' that mandates trades only in the direction of the 4h timeframe, rejecting any setup with a confidence score below 60%.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC less on alts when the 4h/1d trend is clearly defined.
